content.text: All warranty provisions are located; the disclaimer is expressly bounded. No redline needed.

input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets and largely exceeds our fallback, and substantially reaches the preferred position. 19.1 warrants that Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel and that Services and Deliverables materially conform to their documentation and specifications; 19.2 runs the Deliverable conformance warranty for ninety days after the later of delivery or acceptance and warrants the hosted software (within the defined "Services", which expressly includes hosted software) for the whole subscription term, so the software-to-documentation duration exceeds the 90-day fallback floor and the services warranty comfortably exceeds 30 days. 19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law and a no-malicious-code warranty. 19.4 supplies the full remedy stack — prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, and, failing cure, termination of the affected item with a refund of Fees paid — and is non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The 19.5 disclaimer is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties. Minor points short of preferred wording, noted only: the malicious-code warranty is qualified to code "intentionally introduced by Vendor", and the services-performance warranty in 19.1 carries no stated duration (which operates in our favour). Neither is a material fallback failure, so we accept the clause as drafted.
